posts.body_html: This is an absolutely amazing site.  It just seems to keep giving. I wonder how much the rosea genes in the leuco   population are reflected in the pitcher morphology.  You could almost envision a few in the "flat top" leuco.

posts.body_html:
Some photographs from the very first ICPS field trip/meeting in 1997! This is the same property:


Bill Hoyer, who just like me is a grown man now, this was back when we were kids! This is who S. flava var. cuprea Bill Hoyer is named after!


venus fly trap flowers (introduced):


Habitat overview:


hard to tell, but in the background is a field full of leucophyllas. It was early in the season so they weren't in full force, they were mostly just flowering and sending out their less than spectacular spring traps:
